title: Legacy of Goku II Kai
description: Legacy of Goku II Kai is a fan-made overhaul of Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku II for Game Boy Advance. Featuring rebalanced combat, revamped character progression, improved transformations, tougher enemies, updated visuals, and an expanded post-game, Kai aims to preserve the original experience while building upon it. Beta 2 includes four main gameplay variants: Kai, EXP Boost, Casual, and Insanity, alongside three experimental Randomizers, offering different ways to experience the game. Made by a fan, for the fans.
